subject: planner: fix a estimation case when column.hist.NDV is greater than topN.num. (#59564)
summary: Reviewed this commit vs first parent. The functional change is in `equalRowCountOnColumn` (StatsVer=2): it avoids returning 0 when `Histogram.NDV > TopN.Num()` but the histogram is empty (full-loaded stats), by treating it as a TopN-only case and, when `modifyCount==0`, estimating a non-TopN value as `<min TopN count` via `TopN.MinCount()-1` (min 1). Statistics adds `(*TopN).MinCount()` helper. No remaining Blocker/High issues found in planner/statistics correctness or runtime safety for the touched logic; later upstream history contains further estimation refactors but nothing indicating this commit needed a follow-up fix.
